title: Finishing a run
statement: Given a decoder $d:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, an amplified configuration $C$, and a counter $c\in\text{Fin}(r+2)$, finishing preserves every field of $C$ except that the state is set to the halting state and the output is extended by the single Boolean value $d(c)$ at its end.
